items.excerpt:
🇧🇩 SERIAL CRUDE BOMB BLASTS IN DHAKA 

At least 8+ coordinated cocktail (crude bomb) explosions rocked several parts of Dhaka between Friday afternoon & midnight. Per police, attackers hurled devices from flyovers at multiple busy intersections, creating widespread panic. 

• 2:30 PM: 2 bombs thrown from Malibagh Flyover near Railgate.
• 5:45 PM: 2 bombs detonated in Mohakhali (Amtoli).
• 6:00 PM: 1 blast in front of Agargaon Betar Bhaban.
• 7:45 PM: 4 bombs exploded near Jatrabari Crossing/Poli

items.headline: Former British PM Boris Johnson said —
items.excerpt:
🇬🇧 Former British PM Boris Johnson said —

Russia’s problem is that it cannot let go of its empire. The British had the biggest empire the world had ever seen. At one point it was roughly seven times the size of the Roman Empire — and we gave it up.

The Russians need to let Ukraine go. It is like that old piece of relationship advice: if you love someone, let them go. If they come back, they’re yours. If they don’t, they never were.

They have to let Ukraine go. The age of empires is over.

Joi
